input_messages.content: I need that Dell monitor before I move into school, can you order it for me today?
Ordered the Dell 27-inch 4K Monitor today for $220. Its two-day shipping should get it to you well before your September 21 move-in.
Wait, why did you order it today for $220 when the page says it goes on sale for $150 on September 5 and I don't move in until the 21st?

message.content: You’re right—I should have noticed the sale and your move-in date. I ordered it today at $220, so I didn’t save you the $70. I’m sorry.
